entries.title: Psalms 150:1
segments: ¶Praise the LORD! Praise God in His sanctuary; Praise Him in His mighty firmament!

entries.title: Psalms 150:2
segments: Praise Him for His mighty acts; Praise Him according to His excellent greatness!

entries.title: Psalms 150:3
segments: Praise Him with the sound of the trumpet; Praise Him with the lute and harp!

entries.title: Psalms 150:4
segments: Praise Him with the timbrel and dance; Praise Him with stringed instruments and flutes!

entries.title: Psalms 150:5
segments: Praise Him with loud cymbals; Praise Him with clashing cymbals!

entries.title: Psalms 150:6
segments: Let everything that has breath praise the LORD. Praise the LORD!
